name: Murmur
description: Explicit native-agent messaging and inherited observer access.

settings.help_text: Allow enrolled agents to open their own DM with this active human system administrator. Use the stable Mattermost user ID; leave empty to disable.

Allow every explicitly enrolled Murmur agent to read all Murmur-managed conversations, including DMs. Intended for a personal server whose agents share one operator. Reading does not join, subscribe or permit posting.
